203.title: Warning!
203.content:
The soldier calling for help inside this house has fallen into corruption and turned into a monster.
Do not be deceived. Do not help him. Do not open the door!
<align="right">—<style="stress"><player_name></style> and Gala

203.title: 警告！
203.content:

彼の言葉に騙されるな。絶対に扉を開けてはならない！
<align="right">――<style="stress"><player_name></style>、ガーラ

203.title: 경고!
203.content:
이 집에서 구해달라고 하는 병사는 이미 몬스터로 타락했으니 
속아서 돕거나 문을 열어주면 안 된다!
<align="right">—<style="stress"><player_name></style>&갈라
